note: Dates come from the official sites or from news pages that quote the official notice. Always check the official notice before you apply.

items.name: Kerala PSC: 18 new notifications (Gazette 16 Nov 2026)
items.level: Different posts. Some need 10th, some need a degree. Check each post.
items.text: Kerala PSC has opened applications for Category numbers 175/2026 to 192/2026. Last date is Wednesday 16 December 2026, up to 12 midnight. You apply through your One Time Registration (OTR) profile on the Thulasi site. Kerala PSC does not take any application fee.
items.who: Many posts here are only for one community (NCA), only for ST (SR), or only for ex-servicemen. Read the tag next to each post. 'Open to all' posts are general recruitment.
items.pwd: Kerala PSC gives PwD reservation in many posts. The notice PDF of each post says if it is open for differently abled people.
posts: Enquiry Commissioner and Special Judges Office
Police Constable Driver / Woman Police Constable Driver

items.name: Kerala PSC: 10 notifications (Gazette 30 Oct 2026)
items.text: Category numbers 162/2026 to 173/2026. Last date is Wednesday 2 December 2026, up to 12 midnight. Apply through your OTR profile on Thulasi. No fee.
items.who: Most posts here are only for one community (NCA) or only for ST. Read the tag next to each post.
items.pwd: Check the notice PDF of each post for PwD reservation.
posts: CSR Technician / Sterilisation Technician Gr. II

items.name: SSC MTS & Havaldar 2026
items.text: This is YOUR exam. The SSC calendar said the notice would come on 30 June 2026, but SSC postponed it. No new date is given yet. News sites expect it soon. When it comes, the form is usually open for about one month. Keep your photo, signature, 10th certificate and PwD certificate (UDID) ready now.
items.who: 10th pass. Age usually 18-25 (MTS) and 18-27 (Havaldar), with extra years for PwD. Confirm in the new notice.
items.fee: Usually ₹100. PwD, SC, ST, women and ex-servicemen usually pay nothing. Confirm in the notice.
items.pwd: PwD candidates get extra time and can ask for a scribe. See 'PwD rules' in My day.

items.name: SSC GD Constable 2027
items.text: The SSC calendar planned the notice for 30 September 2026. It has not come yet (checked 27 Nov 2026). News sites expect it in November or December 2026.
items.who: 10th pass. Physical test is part of selection.
items.fee: Usually ₹100. SC, ST, women and ex-servicemen usually pay nothing.
items.pwd: GD Constable is a physical post. PwD candidates are usually not eligible. Check the notice.

items.name: Kerala PSC: next gazette
items.text: Kerala PSC usually publishes new notifications around the middle and end of each month. The morning update checks the Kerala PSC site every day and adds new posts here in simple English.

items.name: SSC CHSL 2026 (LDC, JSA, DEO)
items.text: Applications were open 7 September to 7 October 2026 for about 2,536 posts. The form is closed. SSC will announce the Tier 1 exam date later.

items.name: RRB NTPC Undergraduate (CEN 07/2026)
items.text: About 1,688 posts for 12th pass. Applications were open 15 October to 13 November 2026. The correction window was 16 to 25 November. Now closed.

items.name: RRB NTPC Graduate (CEN 06/2026)
items.text: For degree holders. Applications were open 8 October to 6 November 2026. Now closed.

items.name: RRB Group D (CEN 09/2025)
items.text: About 22,195 Level 1 posts. The form closed in March 2026 and the exam was held in August 2026. The next Group D notice is not announced yet.
